_readme: A project can span several repositories. RMS spans two: the app and the buyer portal.
Fill in 'url' and 'defaultBranch' for each repo before running 'npm run sync'.
'url' accepts any git URL: https://github.com/<owner>/<name>.git or git@github.com:<owner>/<name>.git
Repos whose 'url' is still the placeholder value are skipped by the sync script.
Optional per-repo: set compareBranch (e.g. main) to be warned about commits that exist there but not on defaultBranch.
Mirrors are cloned to .cache/repos/<project key>/<repo name>.git and are read-only.
'dependsOn' drives cross-project regression analysis - it lists projects this one consumes or reacts to.
'codeMap' is optional but strongly recommended: it tells the agent where to look inside the repo.

projects.name: RMS
projects.description: Manages return and exchange processes for orders coming from integrated e-commerce stores (Shopify, Custom). Split across two repositories: the app hosts the backend and the seller Return Panel, the portal hosts the buyer-facing Return Portal.

repos.name: app
repos.description: NestJS backend and Next.js seller Return Panel. Owns the return lifecycle, return policy, cargo and shipping, Shopify store connection, wallet, analytics and the WMS integration.

codeMap._hint: Verified against develop on 2026-09-03. Clean architecture: use cases under src/core/application/use-cases, Next.js frontend under src/app.

repos.name: portal
repos.description: Buyer-facing Return Portal. Vite/React client plus a small Node server that also supports embedded mode.

codeMap._hint: Verified against develop on 2026-09-03. Vite/React client under client/, Node server under server/.
